core_problem_solved: To provide an easy-to-use and flexible open-source framework for processing XML in Java using a tree-based model (DOM), as an alternative to the more cumbersome standard W3C DOM APIs.
key_features: An intuitive, object-oriented API for representing XML documents
Integrated support for XPath queries (often via the Jaxen library)
Support for SAX and DOM parsing models
Was known for better performance and flexibility than the standard DOM implementation
era_and_niche: A very popular and highly regarded XML processing library in the Java ecosystem during the 2000s. It was famously used as a core dependency in the Hibernate ORM framework for parsing its XML configuration and mapping files.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is a **legacy library** and is no longer actively developed. For most use cases, modern alternatives are preferred: the standard JAXP APIs in the JDK for basic DOM/XPath, JAXB or Jackson-XML for data binding, or `jsoup` for HTML processing.
